description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You critically hit your Marked quarry with a Strike, and your Feral Bond is within 30 feet of it and able to act.

Your Feral Bond immediately makes one Strike against your Marked quarry. This Strike does not count toward your Bond's actions on its own turn, and its multiple attack penalty is calculated separately from yours.

cinderfall.incomplete: Blocked on the Mark, and independently: granting a companion an extra Strike triggered by the holder's own crit is exactly P7's shape (Companion's Cry-style companion-action-economy grant) — real pf2e ships this kind of thing empty even with a full companion-actor subsystem behind it. The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect. This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too.
